In seeking profitable growth, there are three avenues that any consumer sector company should explore: strengthen the core of the business (the most developed categories and markets); expand into adjacencies (through innovation or acquisition, in either new categories or new geographies); and ignite breakout businesses (mobilizing resources behind big, disruptive bets).
